correctness.rationale: The upstream characteristic roots follow from the exact profile ODE, and the source logarithmic-slope bound excludes the fast eigendirection in the strict monotone regime. At the repeated-root boundary, factorization plus convexity of the exponentially rescaled amplitude forces a nonzero generalized-eigenvector coefficient. At the downstream contact state, center-manifold expansion and reciprocal-variable integration yield the displayed logarithmic term. Symbolic checks reproduce all coefficients and limiting identities.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The source gives dispersion-uniform exponential/algebraic bounds but not the sharp dispersion-dependent upstream rate, critical Jordan tail, downstream logarithmic correction, or tail-based recovery formulas. Searches found no source-specific correction or equivalent SCOPE record. The closest older mKdV-Burgers travelling-wave paper, Jacobs-McKinney-Shearer (1995), could not be inspected in full and remains the main residual risk for prior endpoint asymptotics.

value.rationale: The result identifies precisely where dispersion enters the sharp spatial structure hidden by uniform decay bounds: in the upstream exponent, in a threshold Jordan factor, and in a translation-invariant logarithmic correction to the degenerate contact tail. It also gives two asymptotic formulas that recover the dispersion parameter from the shock profile.
